common.tagline: Authentic Finnish places and local experiences, all year round

hero.title: Discover the real Finland
hero.subtitle: From coastal villages and archipelago islands to lakeside landscapes and lively cities, Finland offers something to experience in every season.
hero.description: Explore local destinations, distinctive places to stay and memorable experiences. Find your own way to enjoy Finland's nature, culture and local life.
hero.microcopy: No package tours. Discover places and services, then connect directly with local providers.

sections.featuredDestinationsDesc: Discover special places in Southern Finland, along the western coast, in Southeast Finland and on Åland.
sections.popularExperiencesDesc: Explore local activities, from kayaking and cycling to sauna experiences, culture and island excursions.
sections.uniqueStaysDesc: Choose from cottages, villas, boutique hotels, seaside stays and nature-inspired accommodation.
sections.whyFinlandDesc: Discover Finnish nature, culture and everyday life throughout the year.
sections.newsletterDesc: Receive travel ideas, selected offers and inspiration for discovering Finland.

summerHome.eyebrow: Find your own way to experience Finland
summerHome.title: What would you like to experience in Finland?
summerHome.subtitle: Choose your pace: peaceful nature, archipelago life, city culture or local food and flavours.
summerHome.midnightDesc: Enjoy summer events, music, outdoor life and the light of the midnight sun.
summerHome.saunaDesc: Discover Finnish sauna traditions and unwind close to nature.
summerHome.citiesDesc: Helsinki, Turku and Tampere offer culture, food, events and neighbourhoods worth exploring.
summerHome.cabinsDesc: Enjoy time at your own pace in a cottage, villa or another distinctive place to stay.
summerHome.storyTitle: Every season offers its own way to experience Finland.
summerHome.storyText: In spring, nature comes back to life. Summer brings long, bright days, autumn fills the landscape with colour and winter invites you to slow down. The changing seasons, local culture and closeness to nature make Finland rewarding to explore all year round.
summerHome.advisorEyebrow: Let us help you get started
summerHome.advisorTitle: What kind of Finnish experience would you love to discover?
summerHome.advisorText: Find your own way to experience Finland – from peaceful moments in nature and beautiful seascapes to local culture, great food and memorable experiences. Discover inspiring places and local providers in every season.
summerHome.findTitle: What kind of Finland would you like to experience?
summerHome.findText: You do not need to know where to go just yet. Start by thinking about the experiences and atmosphere you are looking for.
summerHome.archipelagoDesc: Explore islands, seascapes, boating and small coastal villages.
summerHome.natureDesc: Discover national parks, forests, lakes and the peace of the outdoors.
summerHome.foodDesc: Taste local ingredients, fish, berries and regional specialities.
summerHome.whyTitle: Nature, culture and local life turn a trip into an experience
summerHome.whyText: The archipelago, historic villages, sauna traditions and local services of Southern Finland offer something to discover in every season.
summerHome.smokeDesc: Experience a traditional smoke sauna and the calming atmosphere of Finnish sauna culture.
summerHome.stayDesc: Choose a glass igloo, boutique hotel, villa or welcoming accommodation in the archipelago.
summerHome.tasteDesc: Enjoy fish, local produce, regional drinks and food prepared over an open fire.
summerHome.summerText: Enjoy sauna, swimming, kayaking, fishing and outdoor dining late into the evening. Finland's long summer days offer plenty of opportunities to explore outside.
summerHome.directTitle: Discover a place. Connect with a local provider.
summerHome.directText: Finland Experience showcases destinations, accommodation and experiences. We do not sell travel packages. Instead, we guide you to the provider's own website, where you can ask questions and make a booking directly.
summerHome.directStep2: Contact and book directly with the provider
summerHome.finalTitle: Discover the authentic side of Finland.
summerHome.finalText: Archipelago. Sauna. Nature. Culture. Food. Find your own way to experience Finland.
summerHome.coastalTitle: Five coastal destinations to start exploring
summerHome.coastalText: The historic ironworks village of Mathildedal, the Naantali archipelago, Turku, Hanko and Åland reveal different sides of Finland: the sea, nature, food, history and local life throughout the seasons.
